Embark on an epic quest in Dawncaster, a deck-building game with over 900 hand-illustrated cards. Choose your path as a stealthy rogue, a formidable warrior, or an enigmatic Seeker,or any of the other classes. Unearth the dark secrets of Aethos and face a strategic challenge that reshapes the mobile card game experience.

STRATEGICALLY CHALLENGING

Every step of your heroic journey offers new tactical choices to improve your deck. Collect cards that match your playstyle, navigate challenging events and develop your strategy before the forces of evil overwhelm you.

UNIQUE TAKE ON CARD GAMES

Dawncaster redefines the card game genre with novel mechanics that will intrigue even the most seasoned players. Forge your unique blend of class-specific mechanics, wield powerful weapons, play permanent enchantments and harness a fresh energy system that lifts all restrictions found in traditional deckbuilders.

VENTURE INTO DARKNESS

Discover the mystery of the ‘Dawnbringer’, a hero of legend who has been lost in the corrupted realm of Umbris. Slay monsters and explore the darkest depths of a desperate world through handcrafted illustrations, dialogue and shape its future through your choices.

ACCESS TO ALL CARDS

Dawncaster is offered as a complete deck builder cardgame. You get access to all cards and classes with your purchase. No need to buy packs, tokens, or waste time on timers or ads. Additional levels and battles are available per expansion to add extra depth to your game.

ROGUELITE GAMEPLAY

Prepare for an ever-changing adventure. With randomised encounters, unique classes, choices and battles, no run is the same. Unlock new starting cards, portraits and more and increase the difficulty to push the limits of your strategic insight.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY


Connect with fellow adventurers and the creators on our Discord server. Share your insights, receive updates, and be a part of Dawncaster's evolving story. We value your voice and invite you to help shape the future of the game.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/pfeMG9c
Website: https://dawncaster.wanderlost.games
